Question Text: A cart’s velocity changes from 1 m/s to 17 m/s in 4 s. Calculate its average acceleration.
A cart’s velocity changes from 3 m/s to 13 m/s in 5 s. Calculate its average acceleration.
A skateboarder moves east while slowing down. State the direction of the skateboarder’s velocity and acceleration, and explain why the skateboarder is accelerating even though speed decreases.
Answer 1: Acceleration is zero whenever speed decreases.
Answer 2: Velocity is east; acceleration is west. Acceleration is any change in velocity, including a decrease in speed.
Answer 3: Velocity and acceleration are both east because the skateboarder is moving east.
Answer 4: Velocity is west and acceleration is east because slowing reverses velocity instantly.
